browserQa.summary: Owned Chromium at 1440x900 and 390x844: shared day/night control and saved mode checked across 12 routes in each mode (24 page states), including booking, Archive, Studio, services, journal list, legal pages, project stories and FloorOps. Sampled headings, copy, captions, filters and primary actions had no contrast findings; mobile menu and mode control did not overlap; no horizontal overflow; 28-second ambient transform changed between frames and reduced motion removed the atmosphere.
